MethodsIncluded: Grad-CAM; Grad-CAM++; LayerCAM; Score-CAM; Integrated Gradients (50-step); Guided Backpropagation (negative sanity control)

StabilityMetrics: Perturbation stability (±2% contrast, ±2px shift SSIM/rho); multi-seed SSIM & top-20% IoU; inter-XAI concordance
